create_range_index: create a pandas RangeIndex from integer start, stop, and step values with an optional name
build_range_index_from_range: build a pandas RangeIndex directly from a Python range object with an optional name
test_range_index_contains: test whether an integer key is contained in a pandas RangeIndex
get_range_index_location: get the integer location of a requested label within a pandas RangeIndex
summarize_range_index_union: summarize the union of two pandas RangeIndex objects with optional sorting
